Mellow Yellow by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Mellow Yellow makes it easy to soak up the Florida sunshine. Lounge by your private pool, fire up the grill for sunset dinners, and enjoy a laid-back getaway just a short walk from Seagrove Beach’s iconic white sand. Tucked (or is it nestled?) into the heart of Old Seagrove, this home sits near 30A, a stretch of the Gulf Coast known for its charm and natural beauty, a perfect spot for beach days, bike rides, and grabbing a fresh seafood dinner nearby. Inside, the main level is open and inviting, with a comfy living area, dining space, and a kitchen that keeps the conversation flowing. A guest room with two twin beds and a hall bath make it great for families. Upstairs, the primary suite comes with a private wraparound porch (ideal for slow mornings with coffee), while the guest rooms has its own full bath. The third level is a gem. The hidden hangout, with a cozy kitchenette and outdoor seating area, set the scene for sunset cocktails over the Seagrove treetops.

Very nice. At Oversee 30A, we’re a locally owned team passionate about making every stay seamless. Our office is just down the road, open seven days a week, with 24/7 support if you need anything at all. Overview: - 375 steps (.15 mile) to the beach (San Juan Beach access) - 3 bedroom, 3 bath - 1546 square feet - Gas grill - Wi-Fi - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - 3 bikes included Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Room: 2 twin beds, shared bathroom, TV (24”) - Sleeper sofa, queen, in 1st floor living room SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV (32”) - Guest Room: Queen bed, private bathroom, TV (24”) Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
